title: Project idea: an offline file tool
why_it_matters: It shows off browser APIs and respect for user privacy.
explanation: Build a client-side tool, like a text or image compressor or a document viewer, that works without uploading anything. Use the File API, make it a PWA and cache it for offline use. 'Your files never leave your device' is a strong pitch.
try_it: List the browser APIs your favorite tool would need.
